name: flash-attn
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: 2.8.3

recipe:
  name: flash-attn-split
  # Strip ".postX" from version number because these just indicate wheel rebuilds and
  # are not relevant to conda builds
  version: ${{ (version | split('.'))[:3] | join('.') }}

source:
  # Use PYPI sdist instead of GitHub because they include a specific revended CUTLASS
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/f/flash-attn/flash_attn-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 1e71dd64a9e0280e0447b8a0c2541bad4bf6ac65bdeaa2f90e51a9e57de0370d
  # Overwrite with a simpler build script that doesn't try to revend pre-compiled binaries
  - path: pyproject.toml
  - path: setup.py

build:
  number: 7
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None" or (not linux)
    # debugging skips below
    # - match(python, "<3.14")
    # - cuda_compiler_version == "12.9"

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: flash-attn-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ninja
        - patchelf
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
            - pytorch
            - pytorch * cuda*
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.* # same cuda for host and build
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
        - pip
        - python
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * cuda*
        - setuptools
    build:
      script:
        env:
          # Limit MAX_JOBS in order to prevent runners from crashing
          MAX_JOBS: "8"
          TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: 8.0;8.6;8.9;9.0;10.0;12.0+PTX
        file: build.sh

  - package:
      name: flash-attn
    inherit: flash-attn-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - lib/python*/site-packages/flash_attn/**
          - lib/python*/site-packages/flash_attn-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
          - lib/python*/site-packages/flash_attn_2_cuda.cpython-*.so
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.* # same cuda for host and build
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - python
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * cuda*
      run:
        - einops
        - python
        - pytorch * cuda*
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - lib/python*/site-packages/flash_attn/__init__.py
            - lib/python*/site-packages/flash_attn_2_cuda*.so
      # Cross-built AArch64 Python cannot execute on the x86_64 runner.
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - flash_attn
              pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: flash-attn-fused-dense
    inherit: flash-attn-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - lib/python*/site-packages/fused_dense_lib.cpython-*.so
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }} # needed for DSO checker
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }} # needed for DSO checker
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.* # same cuda for host and build
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcublas-dev
        - python
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * cuda*
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('flash-attn', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - lib/python*/site-packages/fused_dense_lib*.so
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - flash_attn.ops.fused_dense
              pip_check: true

  - package:
      name: flash-attn-layer-norm
    inherit: flash-attn-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - lib/python*/site-packages/dropout_layer_norm.cpython-*.so
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }} # needed for DSO checker
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }} # needed for DSO checker
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
      host:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.* # same cuda for host and build
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - python
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * cuda*
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('flash-attn', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - lib/python*/site-packages/dropout_layer_norm*.so
      - if: build_platform == target_platform
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - flash_attn.ops.layer_norm
              pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention
  summary: "Flash Attention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention"
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE_CUTLASS.txt

extra:
  feedstock-name: flash-attn
  recipe-maintainers:
    - carterbox
    - jeongseok-meta
    - weiji14
